description: decode() reads the six register words with dict.setdefault instead of dict.get, so calling it with a dict missing one or more of the six addresses silently inserts those keys (value 0) into the caller's own dict.

    bfar_raw = words.get(BFAR, 0)
    afsr = words.get(AFSR, 0)
